description: Sets whether a subscription in the current workspace delivers events and returns its id and resulting state. Use it to pause or resume a subscription from list_subscriptions or create_subscription. A successful resume can return state blocked with blockedReason subscription_limit_reached. An API refusal is an error. Use remove_subscription for permanent deletion. Requires `manage`.

state.description: Use on to deliver events or off to pause delivery.

subscriptionId.description: Subscription id from list_subscriptions or create_subscription.

name: set_subscription_state
title: Pause or resume a subscription
